title: MBK's simple enchanting mod
description: MBK Simple Enchanting improves the vanilla enchanting table with smarter, more powerful enchantment options
body:
MBK Simple Enchanting upgrades the vanilla enchanting table with smarter and more powerful enchanting.

Re-enchant already enchanted items, upgrade existing enchantments without duplicates or downgrades, discover rare treasure enchantments like Mending, and reach enchantment levels up to X with stronger bookshelf setups. The mod also expands the enchanting table to 10 choices and includes config options for balancing.

Designed for Fabric `1.21.10`, with support for compatible modded enchantments.
